semanticObservation.oopifBoundary: optional-includeFrames; flattened-session-aware nested refs and guarded clicks

jsonl.consumerCompletionRule: Drain stdout to EOF, parse every expected result ID, and verify moneyhand.stopped for a normal finite run; exit code alone does not prove consumption.

taskModule.signature: run({ moneyhand, signal, args, progress, taskExecutionId })

jsonlFieldSeparation.rule: Never reuse the JSONL correlation id as a Task Space identity.

highImpactApproval.rawRequestBoundary: MoneyHand dispatches explicit Agent instructions. The invoking Agent or specialized Skill owns any business approval policy.

cancel.semantics: Signals one active local operation; the target result defines whether it was aborted before send or became outcome-unknown after send.

drain.semantics: Completes after commands accepted before the barrier settle.

shutdown.semantics: Stops accepting input, aborts active commands, closes the Peer, and returns a correlated result.

resultEnvelope.rule: An ok controller result can contain an extension terminal whose own ok is false or whose status is needs_instruction.
